# Audio effects

30 audio effects. Apply them to a primary clip (`clips[].audioEffects`), an audio clip (`audio[].audioEffects`), a media layer (`layers[].audioEffects`), or the final mix (`project.audioEffects`). With Claude, use `add_audio_effect` and target a clip, audio clip or layer id, or `"master"`. `enhance_audio` sets up a full speech cleanup chain in one call.

```json
{ "type": "denoise", "params": { "amount": 40 } }
```

Effects run in order, after speed and before volume and fades. Parameters you omit take their defaults. Each effect compiles to an FFmpeg audio filter chain ([src/library/audio-effects/index.ts](../../src/library/audio-effects/index.ts)). Register your own with `registerAudioEffect`.

## Contents

- **cleanup**: [denoise](#denoise), [dehum](#dehum), [declick](#declick), [rumbleCut](#rumblecut), [gate](#gate)

## Cleanup

### denoise

**Reduce Noise**. Remove steady background noise (hiss, fan, air conditioning, room tone) with spectral noise reduction. Higher amounts remove more but can sound watery. Noise louder than noiseFloor is only partly removed: raise it toward -25 for loud hiss, lower it toward -50 to protect quiet, soft speech when the noise is faint.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `50` | Noise reduction strength (50 removes about 20 dB) (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `noiseFloor` | number |  | `-35` | Level of the noise to remove, in dB (≥ -70, ≤ -20) |

### dehum

**Remove Hum**. Notch out electrical mains hum and its harmonics (50 Hz in Europe/Asia/Africa, 60 Hz in the Americas).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency` | 50 \| 60 |  | `50` | Mains frequency in Hz |

### declick

**Remove Clicks**. Remove clicks, pops and mouth noises.

_No parameters._

### rumbleCut

**Low Cut / Rumble Filter**. High-pass filter that removes low rumble, wind and handling noise below the cutoff.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency` | number |  | `80` | Cutoff in Hz (≥ 20, ≤ 400) |

### gate

**Noise Gate**. Silence the quiet gaps between phrases so background noise does not sit under pauses.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `threshold` | number |  | `-45` | Level in dB below which audio is reduced (≥ -80, ≤ -10) |
| `reduction` | number |  | `18` | How much quiet parts are lowered, in dB (≥ 1, ≤ 60) |

## Voice

### enhanceVoice

**Enhance Voice**. One-step speech polish for talking footage: rumble cut, light noise reduction, less boxiness, more presence and clarity, de-essing, compression and level evening. Use on dialogue, podcasts and voice-overs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `60` | Overall strength (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `denoise` | boolean |  | `true` | Include light noise reduction |
| `deEss` | boolean |  | `true` | Tame harsh s and sh sounds |
| `level` | boolean |  | `true` | Even out loud and quiet words |

### deEsser

**De-esser**. Reduce harsh sibilance (s, sh, t sounds) in speech.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number |  | `50` | Strength (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |

### pitch

**Pitch / Voice Changer**. Shift the pitch in semitones without changing the speed. +5 to +8 gives a chipmunk voice, -4 to -7 a deep voice.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `semitones` | number |  | `4` | Pitch shift in semitones (≥ -12, ≤ 12) |

## Dynamics

### compressor

**Compressor**. Reduce the gap between loud and quiet parts for a fuller, steadier sound.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `threshold` | number |  | `-18` | Level in dB where compression starts (≥ -60, ≤ 0) |
| `ratio` | number |  | `3` | Compression ratio (≥ 1, ≤ 20) |
| `attack` | number |  | `10` | Attack in ms (≥ 0.1, ≤ 500) |
| `release` | number |  | `150` | Release in ms (≥ 5, ≤ 2000) |
| `makeup` | number |  | `3` | Gain added afterwards, in dB (≥ 0, ≤ 24) |

### normalize

**Loudness Normalize**. Bring audio to a standard loudness. -14 LUFS suits YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, -16 podcasts, -23 broadcast.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | number |  | `-14` | Integrated loudness target in LUFS (≥ -30, ≤ -8) |

## Eq

### eq

**Equalizer**. Three-band tone control: bass, mids and treble, each -20..20 dB.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bass` | number |  | `0` | Low frequencies (around 100 Hz) in dB (≥ -20, ≤ 20) |
| `mid` | number |  | `0` | Mid frequencies (around 1 kHz) in dB (≥ -20, ≤ 20) |
| `treble` | number |  | `0` | High frequencies (around 8 kHz) in dB (≥ -20, ≤ 20) |

### bassBoost

**Bass Boost**. Warmer, punchier low end for music and voice.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `6` | Boost in dB (≥ 0, ≤ 20) |

### lowpass

**Low Pass**. Remove highs above the cutoff (muffled, distant or underwater sound).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency` | number |  | `1000` | Cutoff in Hz (≥ 100, ≤ 20000) |

### highpass

**High Pass**. Remove lows below the cutoff (thin, small-speaker sound).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency` | number |  | `300` | Cutoff in Hz (≥ 20, ≤ 8000) |

## Volume

### gain

**Gain**. Raise or lower the volume in decibels (+6 dB is about twice as loud, -6 dB about half).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `db` | number |  | `0` | Gain in dB (≥ -60, ≤ 24) |

### stereoWiden

**Stereo Widen**. Make stereo audio sound wider (music, ambience). No effect on mono sources.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `1.5` | 1 = unchanged, higher = wider (≥ 0, ≤ 4) |

## Creative

### reverb

**Reverb**. Add room ambience, from a small room to a cathedral.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `room` | "small" \| "room" \| "hall" \| "cathedral" |  | `"room"` |  |
| `mix` | number |  | `0.3` | Wet level (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### echo

**Echo**. Distinct repeating echo, like shouting in a canyon.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delay` | number |  | `350` | Time between repeats in ms (≥ 20, ≤ 2000) |
| `decay` | number |  | `0.4` | Level of each repeat (≥ 0.05, ≤ 0.9) |

### telephone

**Telephone**. Narrow, lo-fi phone call sound.

_No parameters._

### radio

**Old Radio**. AM radio broadcast tone: band-limited, compressed and slightly gritty.

_No parameters._

### megaphone

**Megaphone**. Harsh, distorted bullhorn voice.

_No parameters._

### underwater

**Underwater / Muffled**. Heavily muffled sound, like hearing through a wall or under water.

_No parameters._

### robot

**Robot Voice**. Monotone, metallic robot voice.

_No parameters._

### whisper

**Whisper**. Turn a voice into a breathy whisper.

_No parameters._

### lofi

**Lo-fi**. Bit-crushed, band-limited retro sound.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `50` | Strength (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |

### chorus

**Chorus**. Thicken a sound as if several voices or instruments play together.

_No parameters._

### flanger

**Flanger**. Sweeping jet-plane whoosh.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | number |  | `0.5` | Sweeps per second (≥ 0.1, ≤ 10) |

### phaser

**Phaser**. Swirling, spacey phase-shift effect.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | number |  | `0.5` | Sweeps per second (≥ 0.1, ≤ 2) |

### tremolo

**Tremolo**. Rhythmic volume pulsing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rate` | number |  | `5` | Pulses per second (≥ 0.1, ≤ 20) |
| `depth` | number |  | `0.5` | Strength (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### vibrato

**Vibrato**. Wavering pitch, like a warped tape or singer's vibrato.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rate` | number |  | `5` | Wobbles per second (≥ 0.1, ≤ 20) |
| `depth` | number |  | `0.5` | Strength (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
